_about: Five Oaks Duck Lodge menu and prep timing. Source: /Users/cheflance/Five_Oaks/Prep List.docx (Chef Lance, 2026-10-20), with Chef's corrections of 2026-10-22 (see SKILL.md). This file, not the .docx, is now the source of truth. Each task reads '<offset>, <task>' in Chef's wording. Day offsets put the task on a dated sheet as advance prep; hour and minute offsets put it on the service-day timeline, counted back from that component's course time.
_service_times_note: Chef's times (2026-10-22): appetizers 6 PM, salad or soup 7 PM, entrees 7:30 PM, dessert 8 PM. Entrees were 7 PM and dessert 7:30 PM until the Salad or Soup course was added.
_appetizers_note: Chef's appetizer course of 2026-10-25, served at 6 PM (course 'appetizers'). Each dinner takes one Duck and one Non-duck appetizer, or none of either (request fields appetizer_duck and appetizer_nonduck). Every task comes from the dish's html SOP in /Users/cheflance/Five_Oaks/SOP (reports/SOP Prep Activities by Dish.md in the Five Oaks workspace), with Chef's 10/25 calls: pizza and flatbread toppings at -2 days, spinach dip made at -3 days, prosciutto started at -21 days. Non-duck appetizers will be added later; the Wild Mushroom & Gruyère Tart joined the 3 Cheese Spinach Dip on 2026-10-26, the Southern Fried Catfish Bites on 2026-10-30, the Mushroom & Cheese Arancini the same day, the Crispy Wonton Cups with Sausage & Cheddar on 2026-11-05, the Rustic Eggplant Caponata Crostini the same day, the Curried Sausage Puff Pastry Bites the same day, and the Lemon Shrimp Cheesecake Tartlets the same day. On 2026-11-06 the Sweet Potato Sushi Rolls with Cured Smoked Duck became the first Duck appetizer added after the book's 23. The Blackened Ahi Tuna & Sweet Potato Sushi Rolls joined the Non-duck group the same day. The Sweet & Spicy Kielbasa Bites joined the Non-duck group the same day. The Southwest Savory Cheesecake Squares joined the Non-duck group the same day. The Crab Puff Pastry Napoleons joined the Non-duck group the same day. The Caramelized Onion Baked Brie Crostini joined the Non-duck group the same day. The Leek & Walnut Tartlets with Fontina or Brie joined the Non-duck group the same day. The Nest Egg (Coddled Egg, Smoked Butter & Mushrooms) joined the Non-duck group on 2026-11-08.

Sweet Potato Sushi Rolls._note: Added 2026-11-06 from FiveOaks_SOP_Sweet_Potato_Sushi_Rolls_with_Cured_Smoked_Duck (SOP/Appetizers/Duck Apps), on the SOP's Step 1 plan: chosen sauce made and duck on hand at -1 day; rice rinsed and cooked at -2 1/4 hours, seasoned and cooled from -1 3/4 hours under a 4-hour time limit; duck sliced and sweet potato fries cooked at -1 1/4 hours; sauce out, avocado and apple cut, and rolls rolled from -40 minutes (the SOP rolls at -35); cut and plated from -15 minutes, sauce and onions last (the SOP dots them at -5); passed at cool room temperature at 6:00 PM. One SOP batch is 3 rolls cut 8 each, 24 pieces, 2 per guest for 12. Chef keeps all three sauces as options and picks one per dinner. The duck is a house Smoked Duck Breast (4-day build, its own SOP) or a commercial ready-to-eat breast, so the planner adds no smoking tasks. The service-day rows are combined (8 SOP steps in 6 rows) to keep the heaviest service day on one page.
